children: MAXIMA GRUPĖ, UAB announces changes to the Board of its subsidiary, MAXIMA LT, UAB.
Marius Tilmantas will step down from the Board of “Maxima LT” on 11 September. Aurelija Simutė has been elected as a new Board member from 12 September until the end of the current Board’s term.

As of 12 September 2026, the Board of “Maxima LT” will consist of four members: Jolanta Bivainytė (Chair of the Board), Kristupas Buzys, Vilius Rimkus and Aurelija Simutė. The Board’s term of office will end on 12 November 2029.
MAXIMA GRUPĖ, UAB operates the “Maxima” retail chains and the “Barbora” online grocery stores in the Baltic states.

MAXIMA GRUPĖ, UAB is part of the „Vilniaus prekyba“ group of companies. Through its other subsidiaries, Vilniaus prekyba, UAB manages investments in retail and pharmacy chains, as well as companies providing real estate development and management services across the Baltic states, Sweden, Poland, and Bulgaria.
